SELECT (SELECT bod.spo2 FROM health_data hd JOIN blood_oxygen_data bod USING (record_id) WHERE hd.user_id = #{userId} AND hd.data_type = 'BLOOD_OXYGEN' ORDER BY hd.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestValue,
(SELECT DATE_FORMAT(hd.created_at, '%Y/%m/%d') FROM health_data hd WHERE hd.user_id = #{userId} AND hd.data_type = 'BLOOD_OXYGEN' ORDER BY hd.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestDate,
(SELECT ROUND(AVG(bod.spo2), 2) FROM health_data hd JOIN blood_oxygen_data bod USING (record_id) WHERE hd.user_id = #{userId} AND hd.data_type = 'BLOOD_OXYGEN' AND hd.created_at >= ( SELECT DATE_SUB(MAX(hd2.created_at), INTERVAL 6 DAY) FROM health_data hd2 WHERE hd2.user_id = #{userId} AND hd2.data_type = 'BLOOD_OXYGEN') ) AS weeklyAvg,
(SELECT ROUND(AVG(bod.spo2), 2) FROM health_data hd JOIN blood_oxygen_data bod USING (record_id) WHERE hd.user_id = #{userId} AND hd.data_type = 'BLOOD_OXYGEN' AND hd.created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')) AS monthlyAvg,
(SELECT ROUND(AVG(bod.spo2), 2) FROM health_data hd JOIN blood_oxygen_data bod USING (record_id) WHERE hd.user_id = #{userId} AND hd.data_type = 'BLOOD_OXYGEN' AND hd.created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-01-01')) AS yearlyAvg FROM DUAL;
